entity.name: Aniket Giri
entity.description: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at the University of Mumbai, based in Mumbai. I build open developer tools in public. I created and maintain create-llm, and I have also contributed merged patches to Microsoft Playwright and Graphite Editor.

projects.name: create-llm
projects.description: create-llm is a CLI that scaffolds a ready-to-train PyTorch language-model project in one command, the way create-next-app scaffolds a web app. I built it in 2025 as a third-year CS student, after spending a night going through tutorials that assumed a research lab and a pile of GPUs I did not have. It ships four templates (nano, tiny, small, base), tokenizer training, a training loop with overfitting warnings, and a local chat interface. I posted it on Hacker News on 26 Oct 2025. As of 26 Nov 2026 it has 374 GitHub stars, 49 forks, and about 10,216 npm downloads since launch (https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-llm). It is MIT licensed. I still maintain it while building my company, and this grant would let me treat maintenance as real work rather than leftover hours.

plans.name: A year of create-llm maintenance and hardening
plans.description: One-time FOSS United grant of Rs 3 lakh for 12 months of create-llm maintenance, plus modest GPU and npm/CI costs. Milestones: by month 3, stop embedding Python templates as strings in the TypeScript CLI; by month 6, scaffolding tests and a CPU smoke-test of the nano and tiny templates; by month 9, better docs for the chat UI and overfitting warnings; by month 12, a BERT or T5 template, or a decision those belong in a plugin. At least one public update a quarter. This is a maintainer stipend.
